title: Paloma wins Drag Race France Season 1
summary: In the Grande Finale (FR-S01-E08), Paloma, La Grande Dame, and Soa de Muse lip-synced to Dalida's "Mourir sur scène". Paloma was crowned the first Drag Superstar of Drag Race France.

title: La Kahena: France's first Porkchop
summary: La Kahena was the first contestant eliminated on Drag Race France (FR-S01-E01), losing the lip sync to "Prière païenne" against Lova Ladiva.

title: The Sororité lip-sync smackdown
summary: With no clear challenge winner in FR-S01-E07, Nicky Doll staged a three-round lip-sync smackdown to fill the final three: Soa de Muse beat Lolita Banana to "Dieu m'a donné la foi", Paloma beat La Grande Dame to "Le Banana Split", and in the sudden-death round La Grande Dame beat Lolita Banana to "La grenade", sending Lolita Banana home.
